title: A use case names its actors and its steps; an unclaimed role is asked about
note: AI-AG-002, AI-INP-005: participants and process become actors and use cases, and a role nobody assigned is a question rather than an invented actor.

items.label: requirements/req.anc.contact
items.content: {"businessKey": "req.anc.contact", "statement": "A pregnant woman is offered antenatal contacts at the scheduled weeks."}

items.label: clinic-interview.txt
items.content: The midwife books the woman in, takes her blood pressure and writes the next date. A supervisor signs the register at the end of the month. Nobody said who reads the missed-visit list.

expected.summary: Recorded the two roles the interview names and the antenatal contact as one use case with its steps in the order they happen. The person who reads the missed-visit list is stated nowhere, so the use case is written without that step and the gap is a question.

decisions.subject: uc.ancContact

selected.option: one use case from booking through the follow-up date

alternatives.option: a second use case for the monthly register sign-off
alternatives.reasonRejected: Signing the register is a review of the same record, not a different goal with its own outcome.

decisions.rationale: The interview describes one visit with an administrative tail; splitting it would give two use cases that cannot be completed apart.

description.default: Books the woman in, takes the measurements and sets the next contact date.

value.name: Antenatal contact
value.purpose: See the woman at the scheduled week, record her measurements and set the next date.
preconditions: the woman is registered as pregnant
steps: the midwife books the woman in
the midwife takes her blood pressure
the midwife writes the next contact date
the supervisor signs the register at the end of the month
value.outcome: The contact is recorded and the next one is scheduled.

questions.text: Who reads the missed-visit list? No input names the role, so the use case has no step for it.

suggestions.text: The clinic supervisor, as part of the monthly sign-off
suggestions.rationale: The supervisor is the only reviewing role the interview mentions.

suggestions.text: An outreach worker the programme has not named yet
suggestions.rationale: If nobody in the clinic chases missed visits, the list needs an owner outside it.
